text:
Alex: Heads-up: ran into a sticky UX bug where saved queries that include a pinned model actually change the routes routing when a teammate loads them. Caused a surprise cost spike this morning.
Priya: Ugh. We should never mutate route routing implicitly from a UI state save. Saved queries should be non-destructive by default.
Dax: Agreed. Proposal: saving a view can optionally store a preferred_model hint, but loading a saved query only applies that hint in 'preview' mode. Explicit "Apply to route" button required to mutate runtime routing.
Linh: UX suggestion: show a compact cost delta chip next to the preferred model in preview mode (e.g. +$1.80 / 1k tokens) and a tiny latency estimate. Hover reveals underlying numbers.
Alex: Backend requirements: saved_query row should store preferred_model_id (nullable) and a tiny preview_meta string (json-encoded string) with preview_cost_tokens and preview_p95_ms. Keep row small for fast listing.
Priya: Telemetry: emit saved_query.load {mode: "preview"|"applied"}, saved_query.apply.requested, saved_query.apply.completed {result: accepted|rejected|missing_model}. Also tag saved_query.load.preview=true.
Dax: API sketch: POST /api/saved_queries -> {"name":"...","scope":"route","filters":"...","preferred_model":"redwood/neo-7b-q4","force_apply":false}. Server should reject force_apply=true for non-org-admins.
Linh: Edge cases: if preferred_model not in catalog show banner "Preferred model unavailable, using route default" and set telemetry saved_query.load.missing_model=true. Do not attempt to rewrite routing.
Alex: For Dedicated customers we need an approval flow when applying a preferred_model that increases cost or lacks required certs. Apply should open modal with audit text + approver checkbox.
Priya: Implementation note: add lightweight endpoint GET /saved_queries/:id/preview_estimate that returns a small object (cost_delta_usd, p95_ms) for UI to render. Keep this cached and fast.
Dax: Ops-bot: branch saved-query-preview deployed to staging :white_check_mark: TL;DR: opt-in preferred_model, non-destructive loads, explicit apply flow w/ audit/approval, preview estimate endpoint, telemetry tags + missing-model handling.
Linh: I'll add a Figma frame for the preview chip and the apply modal. Alex, can you draft the RFC for the API + telemetry keys?
Alex: Yep, opening RFC PR now and will include example payloads and the event names. Priya, can you add acceptance tests to ensure route.update is not called on load?
Priya: On it.
